{{Top|leg}}
A '''laundering unit''' was a device capable of cleaning [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] generally carried compact units aboard. Some places, like [[Docking Bay 99]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], provided full size laundering units for crews using the facility.
